content:
Shahrukh and Salman have played roles like Rahul, Raj, Prem, etc. When was the last time Salman played a character who was Muslim, or perhaps "non-Hindu" or "non-upper-caste Hindu"? I mean, what is the frequency? Is it 5% or less?

What would happen if SRK and Salman played roles according to the population distribution of Urban India?

COPY : """India D, India C and India B Combined (Bottom 124.1 crore) : Average Income = $1,300/year = Rs. 1.18L/year

India A : Urban India : Top 20 Cities 16.4 crore

SC = 2 Crore (8.3% of SC)
ST = 0.8 Crore (6.2% of ST)
Muslims = 3 Crore (15% of Muslims)
Christians = 0.5 Crore (16.7% of Christians)
Sikh = 0.25 Crore (15% of Sikhs)
Jain = 0.12 Crore (20% of Jains)
Upper Caste Hindus = 5.5 Crore (27.5% of Upper Caste Hindus, used FLPR, NSSO and sociological analysis)
OBC Hindus = 4.3 Crore (7.2% of OBC Hindus)

India Full : Average Income = $2,800/year = Rs. 2.54L/year"""

Why has nobody ever bothered to "NOTICE" this?

Do people watch the stories of Dalits/Adivasis from their perspective because doing so would change the entire epistemology?

Are there enough Dalit and Adivasi people in the Urban Indian middle class who possess the ability to buy movie tickets, so that movies can be made about their experiences?


Lakhshya L.
Shruti .
Prateek Rational
Ashutosh Singh
Bhavna Sharma
